import.input: An explicitly selected, already extracted local directory. Host does not extract ZIP/RAR archives.
import.trust: Unsigned v1 candidates require explicit source/digest review and approval. Digest integrity is not publisher authentication. Unsupported signature fields are rejected, never silently accepted.
import.limits: 64 KiB manifest, <=256 declared files, <=128 MiB total; package IDs use lowercase ASCII letters/digits/hyphens; three-component numeric versions.
import.validation: Closed file list and SHA256 per resource; reject symlinks/reparse points, traversal, ADS/device names, duplicate case aliases, unknown schema/protocol/capabilities.
import.approvalBinding: One-use main-window ticket binds chosen source, package ID and manifest digest. Revalidate all bytes before import and execution. No auto-execution on import.

capabilities.settings.http: Required. Own local HTTP configuration page.
capabilities.native-game-child: Optional declaration for game child processes. Native code is explicitly trusted; declarations and a Job do not constitute an OS filesystem/network sandbox.

runtime.environment: Only standard OS environment variables are inherited; no launcher-specific platform credentials.
runtime.readyRules: Bounded stdout frame within 10 seconds; exact owned process PID; IPv4 numeric loopback and root path only; OS TCP table must attribute the listener to that PID; no credentials in URL/argv/log.
runtime.iframe: sandbox=allow-scripts allow-same-origin; no native IPC forwarding. Page must allow http://tauri.localhost and tauri://localhost frame ancestors while preserving its own request-origin/CSRF checks.
runtime.shutdownStdin: shutdown followed by LF, or stdin EOF
runtime.cleanup: Owned Windows Job with kill-on-close. Graceful stop timeout then terminate only that Job; query zero active processes before reuse. Unexpected Mod exit closes owned descendants.

storage.updates: Require stopped instance, explicit approval and strictly higher version. Stage/verify before directory cutover; retain current and immediately previous; recover interrupted cutover and rollback.
storage.rollback: Explicit swap of approved current and previous; no host rebuild.
storage.uninstall: Remove approved program versions only. Preserve account/configuration data.

localMode: Mod and original local launch are mutually exclusive. An explicit switch restores local mode. Mod stop/quit never invokes the original global-by-process-name cleanup.
updater: Original upstream host updater is refused because it may erase the extension. Business packages update independently within v1.
validationBoundary: Code builds, OS helper lifecycle, HTTP/API, native transport fixtures and package updates are tested headlessly. DFO entry, real WFP/game behavior, cross-PC play and visual native UI acceptance remain actual-client tests.
